Usage: gotools info [options] <tool-name>

  Show detailed information about a specific tool.

  With --format=json the output is a JSON object that includes a "runnable" flag
  (stable for scripting/CI).

  Examples:
    gotools info goimports
    gotools info goimports --json

  Options:
    --format <string>  Output format: json or text (the default)
    --json             Alias for --format=json
    --text             Alias for --format=text
